x-m-h1-07.title: Mutsetse uchabata denderedzwa here? Kana ruzivo rwunoratidzwa chimwe nechimwe
x-m-h1-07.goal: Fanotaura nzvimbo yemutsetse nedenderedzwa zvichienderana nekukosha kwe constant k, gadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva, uye udzikise renji ye k apo zvinobata.
x-m-h1-07.material: Pane denderedzwa x²+y²=25 (pakati pa origin, radius 5) nemutsetse y=x+k. Chinja kukosha kwe k uye utarise huwandu hwemapoinzi apo mutsetse nedenderedzwa zvinosangana.
x-m-h1-07.prereq.1: Hukama pakati pehuwandu hwema solution kana uchigadzirisa mutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete nehuwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Nguva imwe neimwe kukosha kwe k kuchiratidzwa, fanotaura uye usarudze huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana kana kukosha kwekubata.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Unogona kutarisa huwandu hwemapoinzi ekupindirana nema solution e equation yaunowana kana uchigadzirisa ma equation emutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Nyorawo nzira yekuenzanisa chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse nehukuru hwe radius.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana k=1, mutsetse ndi y=x+1. (Y-intercept 1 idiki kupfuura radius 5.)
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: x²+(x+1)²=25 inopfupiswa kuita x²+x−12=0, saka x=−4, 3, uye mapoinzi ekupindirana ndi(−4, −3), (3, 4), 2 zvose. Mutsetse unopfuura papoinzi iri mukati medenderedzwa (padhuze ne origin) unogara uchisangana nedenderedzwa mumapoinzi maviri.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izvi zvinoratidza pfungwa yekuti mutsetse unopfuura mukati medenderedzwa unosangana nedenderedzwa kaviri.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Uku ndiko kutonga kwekuti mutsetse uri kunze kwedenderedzwa. Funga kuti origin iri kure sei nemutsetse.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uku ndiko kutonga kwekuti mutsetse unobata. Funga nezve chokwadi chekuti mutsetse unopfuura padhuze nepoinzi iri mukati medenderedzwa, origin.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.info: k yakakwidzwa kusvika ku7. Mutsetse y=x+7 unosangana ne y-axis pa(0, 7), uye 7 yakakura kupfuura radius 5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: x²+(x+7)²=25 inopfupiswa kuita x²+7x+12=0, saka x=−3, −4, uye mapoinzi ekupindirana ndi(−3, 4), (−4, 3), 2 zvose. Chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse x−y+7=0 ndi7/√2 (7 pamusoro pe root 2) ≈ 4.95, iyo idiki kupfuura radius 5. Kunyangwe y-intercept iri huru kupfuura 5, mutsetse wakatsvedza, saka unosvika kudenderedzwa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kana ukatonga ne y-intercept oga, unogona kuzorasikirwa nemhedzisiro iyo slope yemutsetse inogadzira. Funga chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kuti unobata here kunofanira kutarisirwa nechinhambwe kana ne discriminant. Unogona kuverenga.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Uku ndiko kufunga kwekutarisa kwete y-intercept chete asi kuti mutsetse uri padhuze sei nedenderedzwa. Ndiko kutonga kunokahadzika kuti intuition nekuverenga zvinogona kusiyana.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana k=7 paiva nemapoinzi ekupindirana 2, uye kana k ikakwidzwa kusvika ku8, hapana mapoinzi ekupindirana.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Kukosha kwe positive k kupi kunoita kuti mutsetse ubate denderedzwa?
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Kana unobata, chinhambwe |k|/√2 kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse x−y+k=0 ndi5, saka k=5√2≈7.07. Kushandisa discriminant kunopawo, kubva ku2x²+2kx+k²−25=0, D/4=50−k²=0, saka k²=50. Pa7.5, D/4=50−56.25<0, saka hazvisangani.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Enzanisa neruzivo rwekuti paitova nemapoinzi ekupindirana 2 pa k=7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Inosangana neruzivo rwekuti kukosha kuri pakati pe7 ne8. Asi verenga kuti chinhambwe k/√2 pakati pe origin nemutsetse pa k iyi chakakura here kana chidiki kupfuura 5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tarisa zvakare ruzivo rwekuti k=7. 6 idiki kupfuura 7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Uku ndiko kutonga kunobatanidza zvikamu zviviri zveruzivo uye kunoshandisa chokwadi chekuti kukosha kwekubata kuri pakati pe7 ne8.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.e: Zvinonzwika zvakanaka, asi tarisa kuti chinhambwe pakati pe origin nemutsetse pa7.5 chakakura here kana chidiki kupfuura 5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Pakutanga zvaiita sekuti kune k=7, apo y-intercept yakakura kupfuura radius, hazvizosangani, asi chaizvoizvo zvakasangana mumapoinzi maviri. Ruzivo rupi rwakakuita kugadzirisa fanotaura yako? Kutarisa kupi kwaungazvigadzirira kuti intuition isakusanganisa?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Kune k=7, tsanangura kuti nei pfungwa yekutanga “y-intercept yakakura kupfuura radius, saka hazvisangani” yaiva isina kururama, uchishandisa chinhambwe pakati pe origin nemutsetse kana coordinates dzemapoinzi ekupindirana.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rangarira kuti maitiro api emutsetse awakasiya mupfungwa yako yekutanga.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora equation yaunowana kana uchigadzirisa mutsetse nedenderedzwa pamwe chete kune k=7, uye utarise ma solution.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakabatanidza here kuti nei y-intercept oga isingakwani nekuti mutsetse wakatsvedza sei?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here makosha awakaverenga (chinhambwe kana mapoinzi ekupindirana) senhamba?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogonawo kutsanangura nenzira iyi kuti nei hazvisangani kana k=8 here?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.0: Handifaniri kutarisa y-intercept chete. Mutsetse wakatsvedza, uye chinhambwe kubva pa origin kuenda kumutsetse, 7/√2≈4.95, chidiki kupfuura radius 5, saka zvinosangana. Chaizvoizvo, (−3, 4) ne(−4, 3) ndiwo mapoinzi ekupindirana.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.1: Kana mutsetse wakatsvedza, unogona kusvika kudenderedzwa kunyangwe poinzi apo unosangana ne y-axis iri kunze kwedenderedzwa. Kuugadzirisa pamwe chete, x²+7x+12=0 inopa x=−3, −4, saka zvinosangana mumapoinzi maviri.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.2: Kugadzirisa y=x+7 ne x²+y²=25 pamwe chete kunopa x²+7x+12=0, saka x=-3, -4. Saka kunyangwe y-intercept ichikura kupfuura 5, zvinosangana mumapoinzi maviri.

x-m-h1-01.title: Gadziriso ye remainder yakakanganisa kupi?
x-m-h1-01.goal: Wana mutsetse usina kururama mugadziriso inowana remainder, uigadzirise, uye utarise mhinduro isina kururama nemamiriro ekutanga kuti usimbise kukanganisa.
x-m-h1-01.material: Iyi i gadziriso yaMinjae yekuwana constant a kuti remainder i 6 kana polynomial f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1. (x³ zvinoreva x cubed, uye ax² zvinoreva a yakawanzwa ne x square.)
x-m-h1-01.thinking.0: Verenga gadziriso yose uye uwane mutsetse usina kururama
x-m-h1-01.thinking.1: Gadzirisa kukanganisa uye uwane mhinduro itsva
x-m-h1-01.thinking.2: Isa mhinduro isina kururama mumamiriro uye uone kupokana
x-m-h1-01.prereq.0: Unoziva hukama pakati pe remainder kana polynomial yagovaniswa ne linear expression nemutengo we polynomial
x-m-h1-01.prereq.1: Kuverenga ne expressions dzine mavara (kubatanidza like terms)
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse wekutanga usina kururama mugadziriso yaMinjae.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora zvakare x+1 kuti divisor ive nechimiro x−(nhamba imwe).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa nhamba iyoyo nemutengo waakaisa mu f.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.0: Remainder kana f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 yagovaniswa ne x+1 i 6.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.1: NeRemainder Theorem, remainder kana uchigovanisa ne x+1 i f(1).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Mutsetse 2 haurarami. x+1 inogona kunyorwa se x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1), kwete f(1). Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inongotevera mutsetse 2, saka kuverenga kuri mukati mayo kwakarurama, asi mhedzisiro dzayo hadzina kururama.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Gadzirisa mutsetse usina kururama uye uwane mutengo we a. Wobva wanyorawo kuti remainder i chii kana ukaisa a=2 yaMinjae mu f(x) uye ukagovanisa ne x+1, kuratidza nei mhinduro yaMinjae isingashande.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora mutengo we x unoita kuti x+1=0.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Isa a yawakawana nemutsetse wakagadziriswa naa=2 yaMinjae mu f(x), uye uenzanise ma remainders.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaverenga f(−1) zvakananga mugadziriso yakagadziriswa here?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakaverenga remainder kana a=2 uye wakaratidza kuti haisi 6 here?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kutaura kuti kutarisa kunoburitsa sei kukanganisa mugadziriso here?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.0: x+1=x−(−1), saka remainder i f(−1). f(−1)=−1+a−1+2=a, uye iyi i 6, saka a=6. Kana ndikaisa a=2 yaMinjae, ipapo f(−1)=2, saka haisi 6.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.1: Kana ndichigovanisa ne x+1, ndinofanira kuisa x=−1, saka f(−1)=a. Remainder i 6, saka a=6. Tarisa: kana a=2, ipapo f(−1)=−1+2−1+2=2, saka haienderane nemamiriro.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Kutarisa nemutengo wakarurama (kana a=6, ipapo f(−1)=6) i nzira yakanaka zvakare.

x-m-h1-02.title: Gadzira quadratic inequalities dzine mhinduro 3 chaizvo dzakazara
x-m-h1-02.goal: Nzwisisa mamiriro e quadratic inequality ine mhinduro 3 chaizvo dzakazara nenzvimbo dzema roots maviri, wobva wagadzira mienzaniso yakasiyana uye uitarise.
x-m-h1-02.material: Kune quadratic inequality x²+bx+c<0 (x square pamwe ne b x pamwe ne c i shoma kupfuura 0). b ne c i integers, uye unoda kuti integers 3 chaizvo x dzigutse inequality iyi. Daidza ma roots maviri α (alpha) ne β (beta), kutanga nediki.
x-m-h1-02.thinking.0: Shandura mamiriro kuita nzvimbo dze ma roots
x-m-h1-02.thinking.1: Funga kuti muganhu (< versus ≤) unokosha sei
x-m-h1-02.thinking.2: Gadzira mienzaniso yakati wandei inogutsa mamiriro
x-m-h1-02.prereq.0: Hukama pakati pema roots e quadratic equation nekwakasangana graph ye quadratic function ne x-axis
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.prompt: Kana pane mhinduro 3 chaizvo dzakazara, chii chinofanira kuva chechokwadi nguva dzose nezve musiyano β−α wema roots maviri?
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Funga inequality imwe ine mhinduro 0, 1, 2 neimwe ine mhinduro −1, 0, 1, uye udhonze kuti ma roots anofanira kuva kupi kune imwe neimwe.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti ma roots anofanira kuva kupi kuti ma integers ari kunze kwemhinduro dzakazara (semuenzaniso −1 ne 3 kana mhinduro i 0, 1, 2) arege kuva mhinduro.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvingava pfungwa inovakirwa pama integer roots chete sa (−1, 3). Edza kana ma roots angavawo asiri integers.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.b: Pamuganhu, < ne ≤ zvinogona kuchinjana. Funga mamiriro apo mhinduro i 0, 1, 2 uye ma roots i −1 ne 3.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.c: Pfungwa iyi inoisa mhinduro 3 dzakazara mu interval iri pakati pema roots maviri uye inofunga mikana kumagumo ose maviri.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.d: Huwandu hwemhinduro dzakazara uye kana musiyano wema roots i integer zvinofanira kufungwa zvakaparadzana. Edza inequality sa x²−3<0.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.explain: Kana integers dzakatevedzana n, n+1, n+2 i mhinduro, ipapo α<n uye β>n+2, saka β−α>2. Uyewo, n−1 ne n+3 hadzisi mhinduro, saka α≥n−1 uye β≤n+3, izvo zvinopa β−α≤4. Zvinogonawo kuitika kana ma roots asiri integers, saka musiyano hauna kufanira kuva integer (mhinduro dze x²−3<0 i −1, 0, 1).
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza integers b ne c kugadzira quadratic inequalities 3 dzakasiyana x²+bx+c<0, imwe neimwe ine mhinduro 3 chaizvo dzakazara.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wawedzera quadratic ine integer roots, (x−p)(x−q)<0, kuti uwane b ne c. Verenga kuti kune mhinduro dzakazara dzingani.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Edza kana zvichigonekawo kana ma roots asiri integers. Funga kuti ungaverenga sei ma integers ari pakati pema roots maviri mumamiriro iwayo.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.fail.c1: b ne c dzinofanira kuva integers.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Kune ma real roots maviri akasiyana.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Hapana ma real roots maviri akasiyana (hapana mhinduro, kana seti yemhinduro isina chinhu).
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.explain: x²−2x−3<0 i (x+1)(x−3)<0, saka −1<x<3, uye mhinduro dzakazara i 0, 1, 2. x²−4x<0 inopa 0<x<4, saka 1, 2, 3. x²−3<0 inopa −√3<x<√3, saka −1, 0, 1. x²−x−6<0 ine mhinduro dzakazara 4, −1, 0, 1, 2, saka haishande.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza umwe wemienzaniso yako une integer roots neumwe usina, uye utsanangure kuti nzira yekuverenga mhinduro dzakazara yakafanana sei uye yakasiyana sei.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Mumuenzaniso une integer roots, funga kana ma roots pachawo akasanganisirwa mumhinduro.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Mumuenzaniso une non-integer roots, rangarira kuti wakaverenga sei mhinduro dzakazara.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakataura nei ma roots pachawo asingaverengwi semhinduro mumuenzaniso une integer roots here?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti nzira imwechete (kuverenga integers dziri pakati pema roots maviri) inoshandiswa kunyange ma roots asiri integers here?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakaverenga rimwe nerimwe kutarisa kuti muenzaniso wako une mhinduro 3 dzakazara chaizvo here?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana ma roots i integers (−1 ne 3), chiratidzo i <, saka ma roots pachawo haasi mhinduro, uye ndinoverenga chete 0, 1, 2 dziri pakati pawo. Kana ma roots asiri integers (−√3 ne √3), handina kudikanwa kunetseka nema roots nekuti haasi integers, uye ndinoverenga integers dziri pakati pema roots maviri, −1, 0, 1.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Kuverenga integers dziri pakati pema roots maviri kwakafanana. Musiyano i wekuti kana ma roots i integers, ndinofanira kutarisa zvakaparadzana kuti ma roots haasanganisirwi, uye kana asiri integers, kutarisa kwakadaro hakudiwi.

x-m-h1-03.title: Unofanira kuziva chii kuti utaure kuti ma roots ose maviri i positive?
x-m-h1-03.goal: Sarudza ruzivo runodiwa chaizvo kupedza kuti ma roots ose maviri e quadratic equation i real numbers dzepositive, uye ushandise ma counterexamples kuratidza kuti chikamu chete hachikwani.
x-m-h1-03.material: Kune quadratic equation x²+bx+c=0 (x square pamwe ne b x pamwe ne c yakaenzana ne 0, apo b ne c i real numbers). Unoda kutaura kuti ma roots ose maviri i real numbers dzepositive (kana pane double root, root iyoyo i positive). Unogona kuudzwa mamwe eruzivo rwuri pazasi.
x-m-h1-03.thinking.1: Ratidza kuti counterexample iripo kana ruzivo rusina kukwana
x-m-h1-03.thinking.2: Batanidza hukama pakati pemamiriro (huwandu, chibereko, midzi chaiyo)
x-m-h1-03.prereq.0: Unoziva hukama pakati pemidzi miviri ye x²+bx+c=0 nema coefficient b ne c.
x-m-h1-03.prereq.1: Unoziva mamiriro ekuti quadratic equation ive nemidzi chaiyo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza ruzivo rwese rwunodikanwa chaizvo kuti uve nechokwadi kuti midzi yese miviri inhamba chaiyo dzakanaka. (Zvinokwana kuziva zvese zvinodikanwa; usasarudze zvisingadikanwi.)
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wanyora zviratidzo zvechibereko nehuwandu hwemidzi miviri kana midzi yese miviri iri yakanaka.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kana, kunyange uchiziva zviratidzo zvehuwandu nechibereko, midzi ingasava chaiyo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.o.a: b ne c zvese ndi nhamba dzakazara
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.a: Unogona kuona kuti kuva nhamba yakazara kana kwete hakuna hukama hwakananga nezviratidzo zvemidzi. Semuenzaniso, x²−3x+1=0 ine ma coefficient akazara asi midzi isiri yakazara.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.o.b: b²−4c ≥ 0 (b squared kubvisa 4c ndi 0 kana kupfuura)
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.b: Izvi zvinoratidza pfungwa yokuti unofanira kutarisa kuti midzi iri chaiyo usati wataura zviratidzo zvayo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvakashandura mamiriro okuti chibereko chemidzi miviri chakanaka kuva ruzivo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvakashandura mamiriro okuti huwandu hwemidzi miviri hwakanaka kuva ruzivo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.e: Izvi zvinoreva kuti c haisi 0. Funga kana yatogara mumamwe ruzivo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.explain: Kana midzi miviri iri chaiyo (discriminant b²−4c≥0), huwandu −b hwakanaka, uye chibereko c chakanaka, saka midzi yese miviri yakanaka. Kana chibereko chakanaka, midzi miviri ine chiratidzo chimwe chete, uye kana huwandu hwakanaka, yese yakanaka. Kuti b ne c ndi nhamba dzakazara hakudikanwi, uye kuti x=0 haisi mudzi kwatogara mu c>0.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.acc.0: e inotevera kubva pa c>0 kare, saka haidikanwi zvakanyanya, asi haisi ruzivo runopokana. Wakarurama kuti wakasarudza zvese zvitatu zvaidikanwa zveruzivo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.prompt: Ratidza kuti kuziva maviri chete eruzivo rwunodikanwa hazvikwani. Gadzira quadratic equations mbiri dzine midzi ine huwandu hwakanaka (−b>0) nechibereko chakanaka (c>0) asi isiri chaiyo (b²−4c<0), uye unyore b ne c.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kuti b inofanira kuva nechiratidzo chipi uye c inofanira kuva nechiratidzo chipi.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.hint.1: Uchichengeta zviratidzo izvozvo, edza kuita b diki musaizi kana c huru kuti b²−4c ive isina kunaka.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Chibereko chemidzi miviri, c, hachisi chakanaka.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.ok.c3: b²−4c haina kunaka, saka hapana midzi chaiyo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.fail.c3: b²−4c haisi isina kunaka, saka pane midzi chaiyo.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.explain: x²−2x+5=0 ine b²−4c=4−20=−16<0, saka hapana midzi chaiyo. Kana ukatarisa zviratidzo zvehuwandu nechibereko chete, zvinoratidzika kuti mamiriro akanaka akasangana, asi kana midzi isiri chaiyo, haugoni kutaura kuti yakanaka. b=−6, c=5 (midzi 1 ne 5) ine midzi chaiyo uye inoputsa chinodikanwa, saka haishande.

x-m-h1-04.title: Mhinduro tatu dzokuti “musikana mumwe kana kupfuura” dzinopa mhinduro dzakasiyana
x-m-h1-04.goal: Kana mhinduro mbiri kudambudziko rimwe chete dzichipa mhinduro dzakasiyana, sarudza kuti ndeipi yakarurama uye utsanangure kuti mhinduro yakanganisa inoverenga nyaya imwe chete kakawanda papi.
x-m-h1-04.material: Kubva pavadzidzi 6 vose, vasikana 3 (a, b, c) nevakomana 3, vamiriri 2 vanosarudzwa, uye musikana 1 kana kupfuura anofanira kuvapo. Seojun akati, “Tanga wasarudza musikana 1 (nzira 3), wobva wasarudza mumwe 1 pavadzidzi vamwe 5 (nzira 5), saka 3×5=nzira 15.” Haeun akati, “Tora nzira 15 dzekusarudza 2 pavadzidzi 6 uye ubvise nzira 3 dzekusarudza vakomana chete, saka nzira 12.”
x-m-h1-04.thinking.0: Enzanisa mhinduro mbiri uye utonge kuti ndeipi yakarurama
x-m-h1-04.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti sei yakanganisa uchishandisa nyaya chaidzo

x-m-h1-04.s.s1.prompt: Mhinduro mbiri dzakasiyana. Kutonga kupi kunokodzera zvakanyanya?

x-m-h1-04.s.s1.hint.1: Uchitevedza nzira yaSeojun chaizvo, nyora vamiriri vese 15 uye utsvage kana mumiriri mumwe chete anoonekwa kakawanda.
x-m-h1-04.s.s1.o.a: Haeun akarurama. Kana ukabvisa nyaya dzisingasangani nemamiriro chete kubva pahuwandu hwose, ndi 12.
x-m-h1-04.s.s1.r.a: Uri kutarisa kururama kwenzira yekubvisa nyaya dzisingasangani nemamiriro kubva pahuwandu hwose.
x-m-h1-04.s.s1.o.b: Seojun akarurama. Kana ukasarudza musikana 1 kutanga, unoverenga nyaya dzese pasina kushaya, saka ndi nzira 15.

x-m-h1-04.s.s1.o.c: Vese vakarurama. Kana nzira yekuverenga yakasiyana, mhinduro inogona kusiyanawo.

x-m-h1-04.s.s1.o.d: Vese vakanganisa. Mhinduro ndi nzira 9 dzekusarudza musikana 1 nemukomana 1.
x-m-h1-04.s.s1.r.d: Tarisa kuti “1 kana kupfuura” inosanganisirawo nyaya apo pane vasikana 2.
x-m-h1-04.s.s1.explain: Pakati penzira 15 dzose, nzira 3 dzinosarudza vakomana chete, saka ndi nzira 12. Kuverenga zvakananga kunopawo (musikana 1 + mukomana 1) 3×3=nzira 9 ne (vasikana 2) nzira 3, dzinowedzera kusvika nzira 12. Nzira yaSeojun yakaverenga nyaya yega yega yekusarudza vasikana 2 kaviri, saka nzira 3 dzakawandisa dzakawedzerwa.

x-m-h1-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora vamiriri vakagadzirwa nenzira yaSeojun mumwe nomumwe, uye uverenge kuti mumiriri mumwe chete anoonekwa kangani.

x-m-h1-04.s.s2.model.1: Maviri ane vasikana vaviri anoverengwa kaviri munzira yaSeojun. Maviri matatu (a, b), (a, c), (b, c) rimwe nerimwe rinoverengwa kaviri, saka pane 3 dzakawanda kupfuura nzira chaidzo 12.
x-m-h1-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Maviri ane mukomana ane musikana mumwe chete, saka anoverengwa kamwe chete.

x-m-h1-06.title: Sei fomula yekuwedzera ye (A+B)² yakasiyana kumamatrix?
x-m-h1-06.goal: Shandisa muenzaniso unopikisa kuratidza kuti mutemo wekushandura kurongeka hauwanikwi mukuwanza kwematrix, uye utsanangure kuti izvi zvinokanganisa sei fomula dzezvibereko.
x-m-h1-06.material: Kune nhamba, (a+b)²=a²+2ab+b² inogara ichishanda. (A+B)²=A²+2AB+B² inoshandawo kumasikweya ematrix A ne B esaizi imwe chete here? Pano A ndiyo 2×2 matrix ine mutsetse wayo wekutanga (1, 1) nomutsetse wechipiri (0, 1), uye B ndiyo 2×2 matrix ine mutsetse wayo wekutanga (p, q) nomutsetse wechipiri (r, s).
x-m-h1-06.thinking.2: Tsanangura kuti muenzaniso unopikisa unokanganisa sei fomula
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.hint.0: Wedzera (A+B)(A+B) uchishandisa mutemo wekugovera uye unyore mazwi ese.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa chirevo chakawedzerwa ne A²+2AB+B² uye uone kuti mazwi api akasiyana.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.a: Inogara ichishanda chero A ne B zvese zviri 2×2 square matrices
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.a: Izvi zvakafungidzira kuti mitemo yekuwanza kwenhamba inogona kushandiswa kumamatrix sezvazviri. Tarisa kana uchibvumirwa kushandura kurongeka mukuwanza kwematrix.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.b: Inoshanda kana A kana B iri identity matrix kana zero matrix chete
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.b: Edza kana idzo ndidzo nyaya dzega apo inoshanda. Semuenzaniso, funga nezve A ne A.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.c: Inoshanda kana AB=BA, asi pane B apo inoshanda kunyange AB≠BA
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.c: Wakarurama kusvika pachokwadi chokuti inoshanda kana AB=BA. Asi enzanisa kuti ndeipi mamiriro anodikanwa kuti AB+BA ne 2AB zvienzane muchirevo chakawedzerwa.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.d: Inoshanda kana AB=BA, uye ipapo chete
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.d: Izvi zvinoratidza kufunga kwekuwedzera divi rekuruboshwe nemutemo wekugovera uye kuenzanisa kuti rakasiyana papi nedivi rekurudyi.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.explain: (A+B)²=(A+B)(A+B)=A²+AB+BA+B², saka kuti iite A²+2AB+B², tinoda AB+BA=2AB, kureva, BA=AB. Mukuwanza kwematrix, AB ne BA zvingasaenzani.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza nhamba dzakazara p, q, r, s (imwe neimwe kubva pa −9 kusvika pa 9) kuti AB ne BA dzisaenzane. Gadzira B mbiri dzakasiyana.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.hint.0: Verenga chikamu chega chega che AB ne BA zvakananga nemashoko e p, q, r, s.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa zvikamu zviri panzvimbo dzakafanana dzematrix maviri uye uwane kwakasiyana papi.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Zvikamu ndi nhamba dzakazara kubva pa −9 kusvika pa 9.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Zvikamu zvinofanira kuva nhamba dzakazara kubva pa −9 kusvika pa 9.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.ok.c2: AB ne BA dzakasiyana (kana ukaenzanisa zvikamu hazvienzani).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.fail.c2: AB ne BA dzinova dzakaenzana. Verenga zvikamu zvezvibereko zvakananga uye uzvienzanise.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.explain: Zvikamu zve AB ndi (p+r, q+s) mumutsetse wekutanga ne (r, s) mumutsetse wechipiri, uye zvikamu zve BA ndi (p, p+q) mumutsetse wekutanga ne (r, r+s) mumutsetse wechipiri. Kuti matrix maviri aenzane, tinoda r=0 ne s=p, saka kana r≠0 kana s≠p, saka AB≠BA. (p, q, r, s)=(3, 2, 0, 3) inoita zvibereko zviviri zvienzane, saka haishande.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza B imwe yawakagadzira, ratidza chikamu chimwe chakasiyana pakati pe AB ne BA, uye unyore kuti izvi zvinokanganisa sei kuwedzera kwe (A+B)².
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Sarudza chikamu chimwe chakasiyana pakati pe AB ne BA uye unyore kukosha kuviri padivi pedzimwe.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nyora mazwi maviri epakati kana uchiwedzera (A+B)(A+B).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.placeholder: semuenzaniso. Kana p=1, q=0, r=1, s=1, AB ...
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Wakaratidza nenhamba nzvimbo apo zvinyorwa zve AB ne BA zvakasiyana here?
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura kuti nei AB+BA mu (A+B)² isingagoni kubatanidzwa kuita 2AB here?
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Wakatarisa kuverenga kwako kamwe zvakare kune B yawakasarudza here?
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana p=1, q=0, r=1, s=1, ipapo row 1, column 1 ye AB ndi p+r=2, asi row 1, column 1 ye BA ndi p=1, saka dzakasiyana. Kuwedzera (A+B)² kunopa AB+BA, uye sezvo AB ne BA dzakasiyana, hadzigoni kubatanidzwa kuita 2AB.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Commutative law haishande, saka AB ne BA dzakasiyana. Saka (A+B)² ndi A²+AB+BA+B², uye haigoni kubatanidzwa kuita 2AB. Semuenzaniso, kana p=0, q=1, r=1, s=0, ipapo row 2, column 2 ye AB ndi s=0 uye row 2, column 2 ye BA ndi r+s=1.

x-m-h1-08.title: Tsvaga kukanganisa mumhinduro inogadzirisa equation yedenderedzwa
x-m-h1-08.goal: Tsvaga nekugadzirisa mutsara usina kururama mumhinduro inoshandura equation yedenderedzwa kuita standard form, uye utarise mhedzisiro nepoinzi iri padenderedzwa.
x-m-h1-08.material: Iyi ndiyo mhinduro yaSubin yekutsvaga pakati ne radius yedenderedzwa x²+y²−4x+6y−12=0. (x² zvinoreva x yakaitwa square, uye 6y zvinoreva 6 nguva y.)
x-m-h1-08.thinking.0: Tsvaga nzvimbo yekukanganisa mukuyerera kwelogic kwemhinduro
x-m-h1-08.thinking.1: Gadzirisa kukanganisa uye utsvage pakati ne radius
x-m-h1-08.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga usina kururama mumhinduro yaSubin.
x-m-h1-08.s.s1.hint.0: Wedzera (x−2)² ne(y+3)² zvakaparadzana uye uzviwenzanise nedivi rekuruboshwe remutsara wapfuura.
x-m-h1-08.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti mazwi api anoonekwa kana kunyangarika pakati pe expression yakawedzerwa nemutsara wapfuura.
x-m-h1-08.s.s1.line.0: Kubva ku x²+y²−4x+6y−12=0, unganidza mazwi e x nemazwi e y: (x²−4x)+(y²+6y)=12
x-m-h1-08.s.s1.line.2: Saka pakati ndi(2, −3) uye radius ndi√12=2√3.
x-m-h1-08.s.s1.explain: Mutsara 2 hauna kururama. (x−2)²=x²−4x+4 uye (y+3)²=y²+6y+9, saka kuti tishandure divi rekuruboshwe kuita perfect square takawedzera 4 ne9, zvichireva kuti tinofanira kuwedzera 4 ne9 kudivi rekurudyi zvakare. Mutsara 3 unongoverenga mhedzisiro ye mutsara 2, saka nzira yekuiverenga yakarurama.
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga radius nemhinduro yakarurama, wobva wasarudza poinzi imwe iri padenderedzwa uye uiise mu equation yekutanga kutarisa kuti pakati ne radius yawakawana zvakarurama.
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.hint.0: Ma constant akaumbwa nyowani kuruboshwe anofanira kuwedzerwawo zvakaenzana kudivi rekurudyi kuchengeta equation iri yechokwadi. Tsvaga huwandu hwawo.
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Sarudza poinzi inofambiswa kubva pakati zvakachinjika kana zvakatwasuka ne radius, uye uiise mu equation yekutanga.
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti nhamba mbiri 4 ne9 dzinofanira kuwedzerwa dzinobva papi?
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti poinzi yawakasarudza iri pa radius kubva pakati?
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakaisa here poinzi iyoyo mu equation yekutanga uye wakaverenga kuti inopa 0 here?
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.model.0: Kuti tigadzire (x−2)² takawedzera 4, uye kuti tigadzire (y+3)² takawedzera 9, saka tinowedzera 4 ne9 kudivi rekurudyi zvakare, 12+4+9=25. Saka radius ndi5, uye poinzi (2, 2) iri 5 pamusoro pepakati, saka iri padenderedzwa, uye kuiisa mu equation yekutanga kunopa 4+4−8+12−12=0, iyo yakarurama.
x-m-h1-08.s.s2.model.1: Pakushandura kuita perfect square, 4 ne9 dzakaumbwa nyowani, saka divi rekurudyi rinofanira kugadziriswa kuita 12+4+9=25. Radius ndi5. Sekutarisa, kuisa (7, −3) kunopa 49+9−28−18−12=0, saka ipoinzi iri padenderedzwa.

x-m-h1-09.title: “Kana n² ari even, ipapo n ndeye even” — nharo ipi iri proof?
x-m-h1-09.goal: Enzanisa kutarisa mienzaniso, kuratidza converse, nekuratidza contrapositive kusarudza kuti ndechipi chinoratidza kuti proposition ndeyechokwadi, uye utsanangure nemuenzaniso kuti proposition yekutanga inogona kuva yenhema kunyangwe converse yayo iri yechokwadi.
x-m-h1-09.material: Vadzidzi vatatu vakaedza kuratidza kuti proposition “Kana n² ari even, ipapo n ndeye even” nezve natural number n ndeyechokwadi, uye vakati zvinotevera. Sia: “Kana n=2, 4, 6, n² ndi4, 16, 36 uye n ndeye even zvakare, saka ndeyechokwadi.” Doyun: “Converse, ‘Kana n ari even, ipapo n² ndeye even,’ ndeyechokwadi: ngatitii n=2k, ipapo n²=4k²=2(2k²). Saka proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadi zvakare.” Jihu: “Contrapositive, ‘Kana n ari odd, ipapo n² ndeye odd,’ ndeyechokwadi: ngatitii n=2k+1, ipapo n²=4k²+4k+1=2(2k²+2k)+1. Saka proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadi zvakare.”
x-m-h1-09.thinking.0: Ongorora kuti nharo iri proof here
x-m-h1-09.thinking.1: Paradzanisa proposition, converse yayo, ne contrapositive yayo
x-m-h1-09.thinking.2: Gadzira nekutsanangura chimiro che muenzaniso unopikisa
x-m-h1-09.prereq.0: Zvinoreva converse, inverse, ne contrapositive ye proposition
x-m-h1-09.prereq.1: Kunyora ma odd ne even number nemavara (2k, 2k+1)
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.prompt: Ndeapi pavanhu vatatu akaratidza zvakarurama kuti proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadi?
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga nyora kuti zvakaratidzwa nemudzidzi mumwe nemumwe zvine hukama hwakadini ne proposition yekutanga (yekutanga, converse, contrapositive).
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.hint.1: Edza nemumwe proposition kuti hukama ihwohwo hunovimbisa chokwadi che proposition yekutanga here.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.a: Sia. Inoshanda kuma even number akawanda, saka ndeyechokwadi.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.a: Unofanira kuparadzanisa kushanda kumienzaniso mishoma nekushanda kuma natural number ose.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.b: Doyun. Kana converse iri yechokwadi, proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadizve.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.b: Tarisa kuti proposition ne converse yayo dzinogara dzine truth value imwe chete here. Unogona kugadzira muenzaniso unopikisa.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.c: Vatatu vose vakaratidza zvakarurama. Nzira chete dzakasiyana uye mhedziso yakafanana.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.c: Hauna kutarisa mumwe nemumwe kuti zvikonzero zvidziri kuseri kwenharo nhatu zvose zvakafanana rudzi here.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.d: Jihu. Kana contrapositive iri yechokwadi, proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadizve.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunoshandisa maitiro ekuti proposition ne contrapositive yayo dzine truth value imwe chete.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.explain: Proposition ne contrapositive yayo dzinogara dzine truth value imwe chete, saka nharo yaJihu, yakaratidza kuti contrapositive ndeyechokwadi kune natural number n imwe neimwe, ndiyo proof ye proposition yekutanga. Sia akatarisa mimwe mienzaniso chete, uye Doyun akangoratidza converse. Kunyangwe converse iri yechokwadi, izvo hazvireve kuti proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadi.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.prompt: Ipa imwe proposition inoratidza kuti kufunga kwaDoyun (“converse ndeyechokwadi, saka proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadi”) hakuna kururama zvakazara, uye unyore truth value dze proposition yekutanga neconverse yayo.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.hint.0: Funga chirevo chemufomu “Kana ..., ipapo ...” chakafanana ne proposition yazvino.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tsvaga muenzaniso unopikisa unoita kuti proposition yekutanga ive yenhema, uye utarise kuti converse yayo ndeyechokwadi.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.placeholder: semuenzaniso. Proposition ... ndeye ..., asi converse yayo ... ndeye ...
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakaratidza here nemuenzaniso unopikisa kuti proposition yekutanga yawakapa ndeyenhema chaizvo?
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakatarisa here kuti converse yayo ndeyechokwadi chaizvo?
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti muenzaniso uyu unoratidza kuti nei kufunga kwaDoyun kusina kururama?
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.model.0: Proposition yekutanga ‘Kana ari rhombus, ipapo ndeye square’ ndeyenhema (rhombus ine kona isiri 90 degrees muenzaniso unopikisa). Asi converse yayo ‘Kana ari square, ipapo ndeye rhombus’ ndeyechokwadi. Saka haugoni kutaura kuti proposition yekutanga ndeyechokwadi nekuti converse ndeyechokwadi.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.model.1: ‘Kana x²=4, ipapo x=2’ ndeyenhema nekuti x=−2 muenzaniso unopikisa. Asi converse yayo ‘Kana x=2, ipapo x²=4’ ndeyechokwadi. Kunyangwe converse iri yechokwadi, proposition yekutanga inogona kuva yenhema.

x-m-h1-10.title: Pane inverse function here? Kana domain ne codomain zvichinja
x-m-h1-10.goal: Tonga kuti function ine inverse function here zvichienderana ne domain ne codomain yayo, wobva wagadzirisa kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva kuti utsvage fomula ne domain ye inverse function.
x-m-h1-10.material: Funga function f(x)=x²−2x+3. (x² zvinoreva x yakaitwa square. Expression iyi inogona kunyorwawo se (x−1)²+2.) Domain ne codomain zvinochinja padanho rimwe nerimwe.
x-m-h1-10.thinking.0: Gadzirisa kutonga kwako kana mamiriro achichinja
x-m-h1-10.thinking.1: Tarisa kuti ndeye one-to-one correspondence here uchishandisa muenzaniso unopikisa
x-m-h1-10.prereq.0: Zvinoreva domain, codomain, ne range ye function
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: Tonga nguva imwe neimwe domain ne codomain zvichichinja, uye gadzirisa kutonga kwako kana waona ruzivo rutsva.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza makosha maviri akasiyana e x uye utarise kuti makosha e f akafanana here.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Kana domain ne codomain zvichichinja, kutanga tarisa kuti muenzaniso unopikisa mumwe chete uri mukati me domain here.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Iyi ndiyo function f(x)=x²−2x+3, ine domain ne codomain zvose ari real number dzose.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.after: f(0)=3 ne f(2)=3, saka makosha akasiyana e x ane kukosha kumwe chete. Ipapo pane makosha maviri e x ekufananidza ne y=3, saka inverse function haigoni kutsanangurwa. Izvi ndezvekuti haisi one-to-one correspondence.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Iripo. Nekuti ifunction inopa kukosha kumwe chete kwe y kune x imwe neimwe
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yekuti kuva function kwakakwana. Tarisa nyaya apo makosha akasiyana e x ane kukosha kumwe chete.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Haipo. Nekuti pane nyaya apo makosha akasiyana e x ane kukosha kumwe chete
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yekutsvaga nyaya apo inputs dzakasiyana dzine output imwe chete uye kuishandisa semuenzaniso unopikisa.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Iyi ndiyo pfungwa yekutonga kuti inverse function iripo here pa poinzi imwe chete. Funga kuti function yose ndeye one-to-one correspondence here.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Deredza domain kuita {x | x ≥ 1}, uye shandura zvakare codomain kuita {y | y ≥ 2}. Zvino f ifunction kubva ku {x | x ≥ 1} kuenda ku {y | y ≥ 2}.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Function iyi ine inverse function here?
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Kune x≥1, f(x)=(x−1)²+2 inokura kana x ichikura, saka makosha akasiyana e x ane makosha akasiyana. Uyezve, range ndi y≥2 yose, saka yakafanana ne codomain. Saka ndeye one-to-one correspondence uye ine inverse function.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Iripo. Nekuti mu domain makosha akasiyana e x haana kukosha kumwe chete, uye range yakafanana ne codomain
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Iyi ipfungwa inotarisa domain ne codomain pamwe chete.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Izvi zvakashandisa chikonzero chedanho rapfuura sezvazvakaita. Tarisa kuti x=0 iri mu domain itsva here.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Haipo. Nekuti domain ne codomain zvinoita sezvakasiyana
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kunyangwe domain ne codomain zvichiita sezvakasiyana, ichigona kuva one-to-one correspondence. Funga zvakare kuti mamiriro api anodiwa.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Kubva ku y=(x−1)²+2 ne x≥1, x−1=√(y−2), saka x=1+√(y−2). Kuchinjanisa mabhii kunopa f⁻¹(x)=1+√(x−2), uye domain i x≥2, iro range ye f. f⁻¹(6)=1+√4=3, izvo zvinowirirana ne f(3)=6. Kune dzimwe sarudzo, f⁻¹(6) yaizova −1 kana 1, saka dzakaipa.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Domain inofanira kunyorwa sedomain ye f⁻¹, kwete domain ye f. Funga kuti inofanira kuva seti yemakoshero api.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Sarudzo iyi inoongorora kana f⁻¹(6)=3 uchishandisa f(3)=6 uye inofungawo domain.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Isa uye utarise kana f⁻¹(6) i3.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.reflect: Waigona kushandisa chikonzero chawakapa che "haipo" munhanho yekutanga zvakare munhanho yechipiri here? Ndeapi mamiriro edomain necodomain aunofanira kuongorora kuti inverse function ipo, uye wakaaongorora sei nepoinzi rimwe pamufomula waunowana?
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.prompt: Tsanangura kuti chii chakachinja pakati penhanho yekutanga nenhanho yechipiri kuti inverse function ipo.
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa kana counterexample yenhanho yekutanga iri mudomain yenhanho yechipiri futi.
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti kuti codomain yakaenzana nerange here kunobatana sei nekuvapo kweinverse function.
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kuti counterexample f(0)=f(2)=3 haiko mudomain itsva here?
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakataura kuti codomain kuenzana nerange kunoita basa rei here?
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Wakafananidza kuti chikonzero chawakanyora chakasiyana sei nechikonzero chenhanho yekutanga here?
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.model.0: Nekudzikisa domain kusvika ku x≥1, mapairi seye f(0)=f(2)=3 haachakwanisi kuva mudomain ose. Ndakaitawo codomain yakaenzana nerange, y≥2, saka yakava one-to-one correspondence.
x-m-h1-10.s.s2.model.1: Kana x i1 kana kupfuura, makoshero akasiyana e x anogara ane makoshero akasiyana, uye nekugadza codomain pa y≥2 yakaenzana nerange. Saka kudzikisa domain ndiko kwakatipa inverse function.
